sentence_stem: If you finish the report before noon,
correct_completion: you can leave early on Friday.
full_sentence: If you finish the report before noon, you can leave early on Friday.
acceptable_variants: you will have time for lunch.
you can take the afternoon off.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' introduces contrast, not a condition, so it does not complete an 'if' sentence.
This describes a past event, but the 'if' clause sets up a future condition, so the result must describe what happens next.

options.text: you can leave early on Friday.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason, but the stem sets up a condition with 'if'.

explanation: The connector 'if' introduces a condition, so the completion must give the result that follows when the condition is met. Turkish speakers may be tempted to choose a 'because' clause, since reasons and conditions are often marked in similar ways in their first language; in English, 'if' and 'because' are different connectors with different functions.
